একটা bug fix করলেন — payment কাজ করছে। দুই দিন পর user complain: "login broken!" Dev বলল "payment fix-এ auth module touch করেছি।" এটাই regression — নতুন change-এ পুরনো working feature ভেঙে যাওয়া।

Regression Testing exactly এই risk ঠেকায় — নতুন code deploy-এর পর verify করা যে পুরনো functionality এখনো ঠিক আছে। Smoke, sanity-এর পর release-এর আগে regression mandatory। এই post-এ regression কী, কখন run করবেন, full vs partial, automation — সব step by step explain করা হয়েছে।

---

Regression Testing কী? — সহজ সংজ্ঞা

Software continuously change হয় — new feature, bug fix, refactoring, dependency update। প্রতিটি change unexpectedly অন্য part-এ problem create করতে পারে।

Regression Testing = previously working functionality re-test করা — "কিছু ভাঙেনি তো?" confirm করা।

Real Example:

Developer search API optimize করল — pagination bug fix। Regression test-এ discover: sorting pagination-এ break হয়েছে। Search fix-এ sorting touch হয়েছিল indirectly — regression catch করল release-এর আগে।

---

Smoke → Sanity → Regression — কোথায় fit?

Test Type Question When
SmokeBuild চালু যোগ্য?New build arrival
SanitySpecific fix কাজ করছে?After bug fix
Regressionপুরনো কিছু ভাঙেনি?Before release
---

Regression Testing-এর প্রকারভেদ

1. Full Regression (Complete Regression)

কী: Entire regression test suite run — সব critical + non-critical test cases।

কখন:

  • Major release (v2.0, v3.0)
  • Large refactoring (database migration, architecture change)
  • Long sprint end — multiple features integrated
  • Production hotfix-এর পর full confidence চাই

Duration: Hours to days (automation সহ)

Pros: Maximum confidence, nothing missed

Cons: Time-consuming, expensive

2. Partial / Selective Regression

কী: Changed module + related/affected areas only test

কখন:

  • Minor bug fix — single module change
  • Mid-sprint build — limited time
  • Impact analysis দিয়ে affected area identify করা possible

Example: Payment module change → regression on payment + checkout + order status (not entire admin panel)

3. Corrective Regression

Bug fix-এর পর fix verify + related area regression — sanity + partial regression combo।

4. Progressive Regression

নতুন test cases existing suite-এ add — feature grow হলে regression suite grow। Old tests + new tests together run।

---

কখন Regression Run করবেন?

  • Sprint end — release candidate sign-off
  • After major bug fix — side effect check
  • Before production deploy — mandatory gate
  • Dependency/library update — e.g. .NET version upgrade
  • Environment change — new server, DB version change
  • Every CI pipeline — automated subset on each commit (nightly full suite)
---

Regression Suite তৈরি — কোন Test Case রাখবেন?

সব test case regression suite-এ রাখা practical নয় — maintain cost high। Priority দিয়ে select করুন:

Must Include (P0 — Critical)

  • Login / authentication flow
  • Payment / checkout
  • User registration
  • Core business transaction (order create, invoice generate)
  • Data export / report download

Should Include (P1 — High)

  • Search, filter, pagination
  • Profile update, password change
  • Admin CRUD operations
  • API integration points

Nice to Include (P2 — Medium)

  • UI cosmetic, non-critical settings
  • Rarely used features
  • Historical bugs that regressed before — add test to prevent repeat

Suite Selection Criteria

  • বারবার fail হওয়া test cases — flaky but important, fix then include
  • Customer-reported bug areas — real user pain points
  • High traffic features — analytics data দিয়ে identify
  • Integration boundaries — API, third-party, microservice calls
---

Manual vs Automated Regression

Aspect Manual Automated
SpeedSlow — daysFast — hours/minutes
Cost per runHigh (people time)Low after setup
RepeatabilityVariableConsistent
Best forUX, exploratory, new UIAPI, stable flows, CI
MaintenanceLowScript update on UI change

Best practice: Automate stable P0/P1 flows (login API, payment API) — manual regression UX + new feature areas। Hybrid approach most teams use।

---

Automation Strategy — CI/CD Integration

Manual regression বড় project-এ time-consuming এবং human error-prone। CI/CD pipeline-এ automated regression suite রাখলে প্রতিটি commit-এ automatically test run হয়।

Typical CI Pipeline Regression Flow

  1. Developer push code to GitHub/GitLab
  2. CI trigger — build compile
  3. Smoke tests run first (5 min) — fail = stop pipeline
  4. Regression suite run (30–60 min) — tagged @regression tests
  5. Test report upload — HTML/PDF artifact
  6. Pass = merge allowed. Fail = block PR

Tools — .NET / Web Stack

  • API: Postman/Newman, REST Assured, xUnit integration tests
  • UI: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium
  • CI: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins
  • Report: Allure, Playwright HTML report

Automation Best Practices

  • Tag tests: @regression, @smoke, @p0 — selective run
  • Nightly full regression, PR-এ partial/smoke only — time balance
  • Flaky test fix immediately — unreliable test erodes trust
  • Test data isolation — parallel run conflict avoid
  • Regression suite review quarterly — remove obsolete, add new critical
---

Regression Test Execution Checklist

Release regression শুরু করার আগে:

  • Correct build version deployed in QA environment
  • Smoke test passed
  • Test data prepared (users, orders, products)
  • Regression suite version / test case list confirmed
  • Known issues / blocked tests documented
  • Defect tracking tool ready (Jira/Azure DevOps)

Regression complete-এর পর:

  • Pass/fail count report
  • New bugs logged with regression label
  • Blocker bugs — release hold decision
  • Test report share with PM/Dev lead
---

Common Mistakes — এড়িয়ে চলুন

  • No regression before release — "sanity pass, ship it" — production regression bugs
  • Same tests forever — new feature-এর test suite-এ add না করা
  • Full regression every minor fix — time waste, selective regression use
  • Ignoring flaky tests — "sometimes pass" tests reduce confidence
  • Manual only, no automation — sprint velocity increase-এ regression bottleneck
  • Automation only, no exploratory — unknown bugs escape
  • Wrong environment — staging data stale, false pass/fail
---

Agile Sprint — Regression Timeline Example

Week 1–2: Feature development, unit tests, new test cases written

Wednesday (sprint end -2): Code freeze candidate → Partial regression on changed modules

Thursday: Bug fixes → Sanity on fixes

Friday AM: Full regression (automated + manual UX) — 4–6 hours

Friday PM: Regression pass → Release sign-off → Production deploy → Post-deploy smoke

Pro Tip:

প্রতি production bug-এর পর regression suite-এ one new test case add করুন — same bug দ্বিতীয় bar catch হবে। "Regression prevention test" culture build করে long-term quality।

---

Metrics — Regression Effectiveness Track

  • Regression pass rate: Pass / Total × 100% — trend over releases
  • Defects found in regression: How many bugs caught before prod
  • Production escape rate: Bugs found in prod that regression should catch — suite gap indicator
  • Automation coverage: % P0 flows automated
  • Suite execution time: Optimize if > 4 hours blocking release
---

পরিশেষে

Regression Testing fast release cycle-এর safety net:

  1. Smoke — build testable?
  2. Sanity — fix works?
  3. Regression — nothing else broken?

Full regression major release-এ, partial regression minor change-এ। Automate P0 flows, maintain suite quarterly, production bug → new regression test। Regression skip = production surprise।
